name: Dispatch Task to Agent
summary: Assign an open task to the best matching agent and run it in background.

steps.note: Find the task or confirm it exists
Pick best agent by specialization match
task_message must include: context, expected output format, constraints. task_id links to tracked task.
Tell user: 'Dispatched to <agent_name> — running in background. Monitor in task queue.'

notes: Agent uses its OWN dedicated model session + personality + tools_allowed
Returns immediately — task runs async, do not wait for result
